mapper.select: SELECT EXPS_YM AS "month", SUM(EXPS_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} GROUP BY EXPS_YM ORDER BY EXPS_YM
SELECT SUM(PLAN_MM) FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id}
SELECT ACTL_PRGRS_RT FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO WHERE PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND WRT_DT <= #{baseDate} AND ACTL_PRGRS_RT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 ORDER BY WRT_DT DESC,MEMO_SN DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ASGN_ID FROM TB_PJ_ASGN WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY ASGN_ID

SELECT DEV_ID AS "personId",APLY_BGN_YM AS "fromMonth",APLY_END_YM AS "toMonth", MON_PAY_AMT AS "monthlyPay",MON_UPRC AS "monthlyRate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_PRC p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.DEV_ID=p.DEV_ID AND a.PROJ_ID=#{id}) ORDER BY DEV_ID,APLY_BGN_YM
SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND CODE=#{code}
